source_label: reference deterministic extraction (original S3.9-EXT run; NOT human Gold)

denominator.observability_policy: unobservable items keep predicted=None and count as FN in the primary macro/micro/exact denominators; an observable-only diagnostic subset is reported separately and is not the primary metric; unobservable scores are never hard-filled with 0.0 or 1.0

paired_evaluation_unified.denominator_policy: all 80 objects (40 control + 40 variant) stay in every denominator; a None prediction (unobservable) counts as an error for both sides; no sample is dropped
paired_evaluation_unified.decision_policy: variant predictions are the PERSISTED predicted_violation_type of the original run; control predictions are re-derived from the PERSISTED control_scores with the original per-type rules, the frozen gamma_ext, and fixed EXTENDED_TYPES priority order for the rare multi-violation control case; no threshold or order was changed to improve results

old_vs_new.note: old_conditional = per-sample prediction 'preset expected type or None' (original panel rule, NOT classification); new_unified = one five-class rule on both sides
